title: Bones GUI
description: This Texture/Resource Pack adds Bone's GUI.
body: Bone’s GUI Pack delivers a sharp and skeletal visual style to your Minecraft interface. Its pale, bone-like tones create a stark and striking atmosphere. The menus are redesigned for clarity while keeping a hauntingly clean aesthetic. Every element feels carved and minimal, perfect for players who enjoy a darker theme. This pack transforms your GUI into something bold, eerie, and unforgettable.-_Maziv_
